main_text.head: CAP. XXIX.
main_text.p: QUod post lapsum generis humani locum habuit, id etiam num in universo obti-net. Ubique pugna est; ubique bellum; ut merito ex antiquis nonnullus dixerit, omnia concordi quâ discordiâ inter sese connexa ac concatenata stare. Bellum immortale se-cum gerunt pugnantia mundi elementa, alterumque alterius perit efficacia & offensione. In-ter astrorum cursus dissensum deprehendimus, & magnam contrarietatem.
Brutorum ut & herbarum perpetuæ dantur & synpa-thiæ, & antipathiæ. Diffidia sempiterna inter mortales serit, Dea multorum origo-malorum Nemesis; quam quis merito Pandoram è cœlo de-

page.notes: The first word "QUod" has a large woodcut-style initial Q; transcribed as "QUod". The subtitle's first word reads "Quasit" in the scan, with the long s printed as plain s; the reading "Quasit" is uncertain, hence [?]. The page number reads "22ɪ" in the scan, taken as 221. Text ends mid-word with "de-" and continues on the next page ("lapsam" is the catchword). The signature "K 3" is printed at the foot left.
